name: Orb · Vectors
description: Field lines swirling around the ball about a slowly wandering axis: an exact 90-degree Rodrigues rotation forks into a clean streak field and a cell-quantized turbulent one, their product drawn as density, with the march itself colour-coded — red cores, green by step, blue by depth (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-22 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
